claims: Toosii has joined the LSU Tigers football team as a wide receiver for the 2026 season.
Toosii is a former high school football player.
Toosii committed to Syracuse in December 2025.
Toosii transferred his focus to LSU in March 2026.
Toosii committed to Syracuse following a call from coach Fran Brown.
Toosii appeared on the LSU roster as a walk-on wide receiver.
Toosii played football at Rolesville High School in North Carolina.
A YouTube video titled "4th&1 With Cam Newton" dated Dec 6, 2025 with duration 04:46 shows Toosii's football highlights and training.
